name: Agent Inbox
description: Adds an Agent Inbox tab to the right sidebar. It gives a high-level view of the workspace plan, the questions waiting on your decision, and the bugs your agent finds as it reads your code. It also lists the follow-up tasks you must do yourself, so you don't lose track of them. Works with Claude Code and Codex.

cover.alt: Agent Inbox panel in Orca's right sidebar, with questions, tasks, issues, opportunities and the workspace plan
